The skill's 'tags' rule (only when a framework is named) was not clearly tied to the template's soc2 tags; I left tags out.

why_confidence: The rule catches the no-auth export endpoint and any future endpoint that reads invoices without login, and parses cleanly. It is not verified with xano policy evaluate (not permitted here), and it does not cover cross-tenant exposure once auth exists.
